source.title: Sacramento Kings new concessions for the 2026-2027 season

notes: October 1, 2026 Abridged / PBS KVIE tasting with Legends chef Rod Cuadra. Not an official full directory. Items without a published section were skipped. The black bean burger was not merged with the existing smashburger. Porchetta House, LowBrau, Star Ginger, Petra Greek, and Café Bernardo were left unchanged.

vendors.name: Legends
vendors.location: Sections named in the October 1, 2026 tasting. No stand name was published for these items.

items.name: Chicken Parm Sandwich
items.description: Chicken parm sandwich with Bianco DiNapoli sauce on a Bella Bru Pugliese roll at Section 106. The tasting does not publish a stand name. Legends is the operator named with chef Rod Cuadra.

items.name: Ahi Poke Nachos
items.description: Ahi poke nachos with sweet soy glaze, avocado crema, spicy mayo, jalapeño, furikake, green onions, and wonton chips at Section 112. No stand name was published.

items.name: Cherrywood-Smoked Turkey Leg
items.description: Cherrywood-smoked turkey leg from R&G Family Farms with kettle chips and house BBQ sauce at Section 112. No stand name was published.

items.name: Confetti-Cake Trifle
items.description: Confetti-cake trifle near Sections 108 and 219. No stand name was published.

items.name: Kings Bark
items.description: Milk chocolate with marshmallows, M&Ms, pretzels, and popcorn at Section 112. No stand name was published.

items.name: Mary's Chicken Rotisserie Sandwich
items.description: Rotisserie chicken sandwich with aioli, pickled onions, creamy slaw, and a potato bun, served with fries at Section 121.

items.name: Paragary Black Bean Burger
items.description: Cumin-spiced black bean burger with arugula, tomato, red onion, vegan jalapeño aioli, and a Paragary's Bakery vegan roll at Sections 115 and 216. Not the elevated smashburger at Sections 118 and 203.

excluded.name: Rockfish and chips
excluded.reason: Described for this season, but the article publishes no section.

excluded.name: Espresso chocolate cookies
excluded.reason: Lounges and special events only, with no section.

possibleDuplicates.evidence: The black bean burger is a different item at Sections 115 and 216. The smashburger remains at Sections 118 and 203. Not merged.
